provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Sylvavéryn is centered at 8.066809, -86.299300 under Theocracy, with 103,614,000 people across 10 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Sylvavéryn occupies 9,634,777.67 sq mi / 24,953,959.60 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 4.892301% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Farming, Partial forest and Beach and grass with water define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Farming, Partial forest, Beach and grass with water and Treetops - treehouses. Population density is 4.152 people/sq km / 10.754 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Harengon, Centaur, Giff, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Freeblade Veil, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Asethyr, Thalunesh, Marduthor, Sigrananna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 8 recorded four-province geography group links, including 7 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Lorren Cabot
npcs.description: Lorren Cabot is a High-Elf patriarch whose mind has been stretched, sharpened, and warped by an ancient relic no mortal family should have kept. Imprisoned for the safety of everyone around him, he speaks with terrifying clarity about buried civilizations, divine prisons, and the thin line between enlightenment and predation. Lorren may be a victim, a monster, or both; the danger is that enough of what he says is true to make freeing him tempting.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Sylthadös is a City in Sylvavéryn, under Theocracy, with elevated danger, Farming, Partial forest, Deep forest terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. High-Elf reads through the Half-Elf (choose an Elf Bloodline) entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Half-Elf — High Elf. Half-elves are dual-natured beings born of human and elven lineage, often balancing ambition with longevity. They tend to struggle with identity but excel at diplomacy, adaptability, and bridging cultures. Table cues: +2 Charisma, +1 to Two Other Ability Scores, Darkvision, Fey Ancestry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Neutral.
rumors: Lorren can describe ruins no living cartographer has reached and sometimes names rooms before they are excavated.
The seals around his chamber sweat black ichor during certain moon phases.
plotHooks: Lorren promises the party a cure for a divine curse if they loosen one prison seal.
The family asks the party to keep Lorren contained, while Lorren begs them to investigate what his children are really harvesting.
